_comment: GOLDEN-63, 1 h, lane_carry ON arm — the CONTROL half of the matched pair whose OFF half
is _golden63_gps_1h_laneoff.json.  Everything is identical between the two files except
network.lane_carry.enable and the output lineage.  See the OFF file's header for the
full rationale; the short version:
- _agu63 inherits lane_carry.enable TRUE from _ft63_24h_conv, and every prior
AGU63 / FT63 arm ran with it ON.  This arm is therefore the COMPARABLE one against
the existing 63-station record.
- _agu305_gps overrides it FALSE, and _golden305_gps inherits that.  So the OFF arm is
the one comparable against the golden305 counters.
- The 305 override was a SPEED call (12x) that CLAUDE.md says does NOT transfer below
~100 stations; at ~60 sta lane-off measured a small net LOSS.  Neither arm is the
obvious default at this scale, which is why both are run.
WHAT THIS ARM CONTRIBUTES: lane ON keeps each primary-pair chord's two band DDs in ONE
jointly-covarianced block (stiff along NL, loose along WL, MW/bridge lane increments as
measurements — M5 card WL-3, GnssConfigTypes.hpp:279).  That pair-joining is exactly what
changes carry RETENTION: whole-block marginalizations measured 0 over 1440 epochs ON vs
735 over 31 OFF, because a per-band component whose chords all refloat is discarded
wholesale where the joint block survived if either band did.  That difference is
UNGRADED, and the A/B against the OFF arm is the measurement.
DEPENDENCIES (verified in the resolved chain, GnssConfigLoadNetwork.cpp:5656 fail-louds
otherwise): lane_carry.enable requires BOTH network.carry_invariant (true) AND
network.mw_wl.ewl_enable (true).  Both hold here.  lane_carry also SUPERSEDES
mw_wl.wl_inject_enable at runtime (warned, not an error).
EXPECTED COST: at ~60 stations the lane layer is roughly cost-neutral-to-slightly-cheaper
than OFF (2084 ms/epoch ON vs 2207 OFF on the 30-epoch arms), NOT the 12x disaster it is
at 305.  Do not import the 305 timing intuition here.
PARALLELISM: identical to the OFF arm and to golden305 — eigen_threads 20,
parallel_stations, parallel_seam, parallel_carry all true; parallel_reduce OFF (mutex
with parallel_carry; ceiling ~1.02x vs pcarry's 2.13x).  Note lane_carry.fold_blocked and
lane_carry.parallel_components are LIVE on this arm (they are inert only when the lane is
off) but are deliberately left at their defaults so the pair differs in ONE knob only.
FRESH LINEAGE ONLY: arms fingerprinted knobs, so it must converge fresh.  Its output
paths are its own — never resume it onto another arm's snapshot.
